fusion_summary: Current WP807 is a useful conservative inner four-capability falsifier but a single shared holdout_set_id is not enough to establish cross-family generalization.

Primary benchmark evidence converges on evaluator-owned end-state scoring, explicit task-family breadth, deterministic/verifiable task generation, repeated reliability where stochasticity exists, and semantics-preserving perturbation controls.

Recommended architecture preserves current WP807 as the inner matched-capability gate and adds only a thin successor/outer GeneralizationBundleEvidence layer if an executable benchmark-mimic counterexample demonstrates additional discrimination.

For deterministic repository components, repeated identical runs are reproducibility only; reliability evidence should come from distinct deterministic variants/fixtures until stochastic model/runtime candidates exist.
Metamorphic performance drops are robustness/benchmark-specificity evidence, not proof of training contamination or lack of cognition.
WP805 interruption/recovery should be reused rather than duplicating a second fault-injection/recovery authority.
next_discriminator: Construct a deliberately surface-keyed benchmark-mimic policy and a general public-only policy under one sealed candidate identity. If both satisfy the current single-family WP807 inner gate but only the general policy survives a disjoint fixture family plus semantics-preserving label bijection, promote toward E4 ablation/E5 build candidate. If current WP807 already rejects the mimic, do not add the outer layer.
